name: branding-cartoon-character-heads-four-grumpy-faces
title: Four cartoon character heads with exaggerated expressions on dark maroon
whatItIs: Four flat cartoon heads on dark maroon with thick black outlines: a spiky-haired scarred guy sticking out his tongue, a worried chef in a hat, a big-nosed bearded man, and a sulky face under a purple beanie.
whatItMeans: Humorous and characterful; exaggerated features give each face a personality instantly.
techniques: Use consistent line weight across a cast.
Keep a muted skin palette and one accent per head.

vocabulary.definition: A set showing characters' designs together.
